said Deed of Trust, nor modify nor alter in any respect any of the terms, covenants, conditions, or
obligations thereof, and said Deed of Trust and all obligations secured thereby are hereby reinstated and
shall be said and remain in force the same as if said Declaration and Notice had not been given.
